behaviour: each round builds a row map of 0x30 rows from the address set in argument 6: words 0 and 1 (position_index), word 2 (margin_available), address at +0x18

account value of every row in map order, i64::MIN panics, shortfall = max(0, -value). A row with word 0 low dword 1 needs dex id == dex +0x30 and index < dex +0x10, else panic; market byte +0x28 != 0 makes it immediate. Otherwise a search of the address set in argument 8 can make it immediate. An immediate row is copied to the first list and adds nothing to the total; all others add to total_shortfall, u64 saturating with a log
total_shortfall >= dex +0x248 (adl_shortfall_remaining), unsigned: the whole row map replaces the list. Below it only the immediate rows go on. 0 >= 0 takes this arm

word 0 low dword 1: the row of id word 1 when it exists, any size and tag. Otherwise every position with size != 0 and tag dword 0. Each adds the address to id map out +0x20 and a row (word 0, word 1, address) to key (id, size <= 0)

mode byte != 2: `immediate adl`, `Auto-deleveragings triggered` with total and word when a key exists, else `Not performing auto-deleveraging` when total != 0. These and the two later texts go to a list that is only freed
keys go to the collector once; each key then removes its set from the map; a key with no set leaves root 0
key loop in key order: index id % 10000 past argument 5 panics bounds; price = +0x20 of row 0x60 * index
rows in list order; word 0 == 2 ends the list; no position or size 0 skips; left = size
last key of the set (highest rank, then address). No root or no key panics none. Candidate with no row or size 0 is removed and the next is read
|size| > |left|: candidate stays, delta = -left, left i64::MIN panics. Otherwise it is removed and delta = its size. Sign is not checked: a candidate on the target side grows the target
exchange +0x38 read as the id, then + 1 saturating, also with settlement off
key side 1: target first, candidate second. Side 0: candidate first. Each with its size before this step

dex +0x2ec == 1 only. Word 0 == 0: no move. Low dword 1: row of id word 1, oracle * size + raw margin, saturating; oracle below 0 or overflow panics none, tag bit 0 clear panics text. Other word 0: summary word 0 - word 1, word 1 below 0 panics unwrap. Amount > 0 leaves raw margin when the row of the key has tag byte != 0, else the balance, saturating; account joins +0x188; total of the id rewritten
fill(id, price, delta, target), then the same amount goes back in the same way, then delta i64::MIN panics, then fill(id, price, -delta, candidate). Status != 0x186 panics unwrap

|delta| * price as unsigned above 2^63 - 2 panics none. Row of 0x248 in the round map under the key: tag 1 and start size, id, first address at +0x8/+0xd0/+0xd8; second at +0x108/+0x1d0/+0x1d8; price +0x200, id +0x208, |delta| +0x210, notional +0x218, exchange +0x60 bytes at +0x228, side +0x234, words 0 and 1 of the target row at +0x238
left += delta saturating with a log, never reread from the row; loop until 0

dex +0x2ec == 1, list order until word 0 == 2: value below margin_available builds `balance decreased`; a row still open builds `non-zero final szi`. Value > 0: the value leaves raw margin (word 0 low dword 1, tag byte 0 panics text) or the balance, saturating, then goes to the fee credit 0x37067b0 with argument 7
settlement on and rows made: both addresses of every row join the set in argument 6, rows move to out +0, and the round runs again. Otherwise exit
out +0 key map of rows, +0x18 round count, +0x20 id map of addresses. Settlement off: rows are freed and out +0 stays empty, the fill id still moved
